newsitem.title: MEXICO: Republic Bank to be included in Mexico TIIE rate.
newsitem.headline: Republic Bank to be included in Mexico TIIE rate.

text.p: The Mexico subsidiary of the Republic National Bank of New York will be included in calculating the TIIE 28-day interbank interest rate, the Banco de Mexico said on Monday.
The central bank did not say when the change would take effect.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average of rates at which Mexican banks lend money to one another and the central bank. It is revised daily.
Republic New York Corp is the holding company for Republic National Bank of New York.
